name: fireworks
summary:
Successfully completed the Fireworks AI quickstart end-to-end. A chat completion was returned from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response "¡Hola!" was received when asking the model to say hello in Spanish.

Steps completed:
1. Fetched the quickstart documentation from https://docs.fireworks.ai/getting-started/quickstart
2. Verified the FIREWORKS_API_KEY environment variable was already set in the sandbox
3. Installed the OpenAI Python SDK (already present in the environment)
4. Created a Python script following the quickstart's OpenAI SDK example
5. Ran the script and received a successful chat completion response
deviations: The quickstart documentation specifies model ID "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", but that model returned a 404 error ("Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"). I queried the Fireworks models API to discover available models and substituted "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-pro" instead, which succeeded. This is a deviation from the exact quickstart code due to the documented model no longer being available.
